screens.title: Closed Tasks (Interactive)
screens.prompt:
I need to make the "Closed Tasks" screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_14}}) interactive by adding prototype links:
1. Link the settings gear icon in the header to the Settings screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_10}}).
2. Link the task cards (showing address and customer name) to the Task Details screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_12}}).
3. Link the "Inbox" button in the bottom navigation menu to the Inbox screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_15}}).
4. The "Closed" button in the bottom menu should remain styled as the active state.
Maintain the exact visual style of the original screen, including the purple header (#663479), the specific card layouts with icons, and all Russian text.

outputComponents.text:
I've updated the **Closed Tasks** screen with the following interactive links to complete your prototype:

*   **Settings Gear**: Tapping the gear icon now navigates to the **Settings** screen.
*   **Task Cards**: Clicking any of the closed task cards opens the **Task Details** view.
*   **Bottom Navigation**: Tapping the **Inbox** icon returns you to the **Inbox** screen.

The Beltelecom brand identity and Russian localization have been strictly preserved. You can now test the full flow through the Stitch preview.
